repairs.quote: Warwick's Attacks deal an additional ((6 ~ 55) + (15% bonus Attack Damage) + (10% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit. If Warwick is below 50% Health, he also heals for 100% of the damage dealt by Eternal Hunger. If Warwick is below 25% health, the healing is increased to 250% of the damage dealt.
